_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
_metadata.role: Main menu manifest indexing selectable log configuration profiles ('settings').
invariants: Every menu item must resolve to an existing, valid configuration data file within data/log/
The default_setting identifier must be an exact match to a registered menu item id
All configuration properties referenced must adhere to include/util/log/log.h contracts
Strict conformance to the OmniCode 5-Block Ontological Architecture

menu.title: Log Configuration & Telemetry Menu
menu.subtitle: Select active engine logging profile and diagnostic settings

settings.label: Default Baseline Profile
settings.description: Standard out-of-the-box configuration matching the Layer 0 log_get_default_config() baseline.

settings.label: Development & Interactive Debugging
settings.description: High-verbosity developer profile with real-time ANSI color console echoing, categorized file writes, and detailed turn traces.

settings.label: Production / Shipping Release
settings.description: Optimized release profile suppressing low-level debug spam, silencing terminal console echo, and enforcing clean 5 MB rotated archives.

settings.label: Forensic Telemetry & Flight Recorder
settings.description: Exhaustive instrumentation mode recording monotonic clock drift, moral sway gradient percentages, and 64-slot circular ring buffer dumps.

settings.label: Quiet Headless CI & Benchmark
settings.description: Minimal overhead (< 50µs tick target) for automated CTest runs. Suppresses console echoing and captures only WARNING, ERROR, and FATAL events.

settings.label: Combat & Relic Stance Telemetry Focus
settings.description: Specialized profile routing combat stance shifts (Warding, Striking, Equilibrium) and skill calculations (Lux Barrio, Cuttatio) to priority streams.

invariants_verified: All referenced target files exist in the same directory
